title: TenantConfig
description: Per-tenant theme + brand configuration. Maps to the 3-axis white-label contract (color + gradient + logo) — Pattern #04, #47.

primaryColor.description: Brand `--primary` hex. Drives sidebar (if solid), CTAs, accents.

secondaryColor.description: Lightest tint of primary, used for selected-row bg, focus rings.

sidebarGradientStops.description: Pattern #47 — multi-stop linear-gradient stop list. Omit for solid-sidebar tenants.

color.description: Any valid CSS color (hex or rgb()).

logoSvgPath.description: Absolute or import-resolvable path to the tenant logo SVG.

logoIconSvgPath.description: Square icon-only version of the logo (top-left collapsed sidebar).

fontFamily.description: Tenant-immutable today; here for future overrides.

modules.description: Module ids enabled for this tenant. Used by ModuleRegistry to render nav.
